title: Marqeta Card
description: A Marqeta payment card resource. Cards are derived from card products and represent individual physical or virtual payment instruments issued to a cardholder. Each card belongs to a card product that defines its behavior, network affiliation, spending controls, and fulfillment options. Cards have a lifecycle managed through card transitions (UNACTIVATED -> ACTIVE -> SUSPENDED | TERMINATED).

token.description: Unique identifier for the card on the Marqeta platform.

card_product_token.description: Token of the card product this card was derived from. The card product controls the card's behavior and spending controls.

user_token.description: Token of the cardholder (user) who owns this card.

business_token.description: Token of the business account holder who owns this card, if applicable.

last_four.description: Last four digits of the card's primary account number (PAN).

pan.description: Full 16-digit primary account number. Only returned at card creation when show_pan=true is specified.

cvv_number.description: Card verification value (CVV2). Only returned at card creation when show_cvv_number=true is specified.

expiration.description: Card expiration date in MMYY format.

expiration_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp representing the exact card expiration date and time.

state.description: Current state in the card lifecycle.

state_reason.description: Human-readable reason for the current card state.

fulfillment_status.description: Current fulfillment status for physical cards tracking production and delivery progress.

pin_is_set.description: Whether a PIN has been set for this card.

translate_pin_from_control_token.description: Control token for PIN translation, if applicable.

instrument_type.description: Physical form factor of the card.

expedite.description: Whether expedited fulfillment was requested for this physical card.

metadata.description: Key-value pairs of custom metadata associated with this card. Maximum 20 pairs.

created_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the card was created.

last_modified_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the card record was last modified.

CardFulfillment.description: Fulfillment configuration and shipping details for a physical card.

CardShipping.description: Shipping method and address for physical card delivery.

method.description: Shipping service level for card delivery.

care_of_line.description: Care-of line printed on the card envelope.

ShippingAddress.description: Physical mailing address for card shipping.

state.description: State or province (two-letter abbreviation for US).

CardPersonalization.description: Custom personalization details printed on the physical card.

text.description: Text printed on the card face.

name_line_1.description: First name line on the card.

value.description: Text to print on name line 1.

name_line_2.description: Second name line on the card.

value.description: Text to print on name line 2.

images.description: Custom images to print on the card.

name.description: Name of the card image design.
